select `companies`.`name` as `company_name`, `company_employee`.`total_employee`, `checked_in_employee`.`total_checked_in_employee`, `checked_out_employee`.`total_checked_out_employee`, `holidays`.`total_holidays`, `on_leave_today`.`total_on_leave`, `paid_leaves`.`total_paid_leaves`, `pending_leave_requests`.`total_pending_leave_requests`, `departments`.`total_departments`, `projects`.`total_projects` from `companies` left join (select `company_id`, COUNT(id) as total_employee from `users` where `deleted_at` is null and `status` = 'verified' and `is_active` = 1 group by `company_id`) as `company_employee` on `companies`.`id` = `company_employee`.`company_id` left join (select `company_id`, COUNT(id) as total_departments from `departments` where `is_active` = 1 group by `company_id`) as `departments` on `companies`.`id` = `departments`.`company_id` left join (select `attendances`.`company_id`, COUNT(attendances.id) as total_checked_in_employee from `attendances` left join `users` on `attendances`.`user_id` = `users`.`id` where date(`attendances`.`attendance_date`) = '2026-04-17' and `attendances`.`check_in_at` is not null group by `attendances`.`company_id`) as `checked_in_employee` on `companies`.`id` = `checked_in_employee`.`company_id` left join (select `attendances`.`company_id`, COUNT(attendances.id) as total_checked_out_employee from `attendances` left join `users` on `attendances`.`user_id` = `users`.`id` where date(`attendances`.`attendance_date`) = '2026-04-17' and `attendances`.`check_in_at` is not null and `attendances`.`check_out_at` is not null group by `attendances`.`company_id`) as `checked_out_employee` on `companies`.`id` = `checked_out_employee`.`company_id` left join (select `company_id`, count(id) as total_holidays from `holidays` where `is_active` = '1' and year(`event_date`) = '2026-04-17' group by `company_id`) as `holidays` on `companies`.`id` = `holidays`.`company_id` left join (select `leave_requests_master`.`company_id`, count(leave_requests_master.id) as total_on_leave from `leave_requests_master` left join `users` on `leave_requests_master`.`requested_by` = `users`.`id` where date(`leave_requests_master`.`leave_from`) <= '2026-04-17' and date(`leave_requests_master`.`leave_to`) >= '2026-04-17' and `leave_requests_master`.`status` = 'approved' group by `leave_requests_master`.`company_id`) as `on_leave_today` on `companies`.`id` = `on_leave_today`.`company_id` left join (select `company_id`, sum(leave_allocated) as total_paid_leaves from `leave_types` where `leave_allocated` is not null and `is_active` = '1' group by `company_id`) as `paid_leaves` on `companies`.`id` = `paid_leaves`.`company_id` left join (select `leave_requests_master`.`company_id`, count(leave_requests_master.id) as total_pending_leave_requests from `leave_requests_master` left join `users` on `leave_requests_master`.`requested_by` = `users`.`id` where `leave_requests_master`.`status` = 'pending' and year(`leave_requests_master`.`leave_requested_date`) = '2026-04-17' group by `leave_requests_master`.`company_id`) as `pending_leave_requests` on `companies`.`id` = `pending_leave_requests`.`company_id` left join (select COALESCE(users.company_id, 1) as company_id, count(projects.id) as total_projects from `projects` left join `users` on `projects`.`created_by` = `users`.`id` group by COALESCE(users.company_id, 1)) as `projects` on `companies`.`id` = `projects`.`company_id` where `companies`.`is_active` = 1 and `companies`.`id` = 1 limit 1
